capabilities: Arrange, resize, align, and caption images in rows
Drag, duplicate, and reorder Markdown blocks
Insert note structures via customizable slash commands
Format selected text with a floating toolbar
Insert symbols and emoji from a searchable picker
extras: Pending acceptance into the official community plugin directory (manual install only for now); mobile support is unverified; the full feature reference and screenshots live in separate docs/feature_list files rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Better Edit adds a visual editing layer to Obsidian Live Preview
motivation: The README frames the goal as working visually in Live Preview while keeping notes readable in Source mode, Git diffs, and exports.
problem: In Live Preview, arranging images, moving blocks, and inserting common structures means hand-editing Markdown markers instead of working visually.
summary: Editing toolbox for Live Preview that adds image arrangement, block drag and drop, slash commands, a floating text styling toolbar, and a symbol picker.
